articles.title: “Love, Murder and Mob Justice”: Man Dies After Killing Woman and Being Thrashed by Crowd in Telanga
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case from Telangana’s Mahabubnagar district has taken a dramatic turn after the accused, who allegedly slit a young woman’s throat in broad daylight, died while undergoing treatment following a mob assault.

body.html:
A shocking murder case from Telangana’s Mahabubnagar district has taken a dramatic turn after the accused, who allegedly slit a young woman’s throat in broad daylight, died while undergoing treatment following a mob assault.

The victim, identified as Vaishnavi (21), was allegedly attacked and killed by a jilted lover near her house in Nimmalabayigadda area of Jadcherla town on Saturday evening.

According to police, the accused, identified as Teja alias Ramchander, aged between 28 and 30 and reportedly a resident of Hyderabad, attacked Vaishnavi with a knife after she allegedly rejected his romantic advances.

Vaishnavi was working as a receptionist at SVKR School in Polepally Special Economic Zone (SEZ). She had reportedly just returned from work and got down from an autorickshaw when the accused attacked her barely 100 metres away from her house.

Police said the accused slit her throat and stabbed her multiple times, causing severe injuries. She was rushed to a hospital, where doctors declared her dead.

Following the attack, enraged locals chased the accused for nearly 400 metres, caught him, tied his hands and legs with ropes, and allegedly assaulted him brutally. He suffered serious injuries in the mob attack and was shifted to Mahabubnagar Government Medical College Hospital in critical condition.

Mahabubnagar Deputy Superintendent of Police P. Venkateswarlu said the accused died around 11 pm on Saturday while undergoing treatment.

Police stated that no identity proof or mobile phone was found with the accused, making identification difficult initially. Officials said efforts are underway to gather more details using Vaishnavi’s call data records.

Videos circulating on social media reportedly show the injured accused telling onlookers that he had been in a relationship with Vaishnavi for the past few years and alleging that she had taken money from him and cheated him in the name of love.

A police officer said the accused and the victim had become acquainted earlier when Vaishnavi was working at a private school in Hyderabad. Disputes reportedly arose after she rejected his advances.

Vaishnavi’s body was shifted to Jadcherla Government Hospital for post-mortem examination, while the accused’s body has been preserved at Mahabubnagar Government Hospital.

Police have launched a detailed investigation into the incident.

articles.title: “Bengaluru Turning Unsafe?”: Auto Driver Chased and Beaten With Rods in Broad Daylight
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of daylight violence in Bengaluru has triggered widespread concern after an auto-rickshaw driver was allegedly dragged out of his vehicle and brutally assaulted by two men near C College, Devasandra, under the jurisdiction of KR Puram Police Station.

body.html:
A shocking incident of daylight violence in Bengaluru has triggered widespread concern after an auto-rickshaw driver was allegedly dragged out of his vehicle and brutally assaulted by two men near C College, Devasandra, under the jurisdiction of KR Puram Police Station.

The victim, identified as Venkatesh Papayya, a resident of the Seegehalli Slum Board area, was reportedly attacked around 2:30 p.m. on Friday shortly after dropping passengers.

According to reports, two men identified as Dilip and Likeesh from Basavanapura village, said to be known rowdies with multiple criminal cases against them, approached the auto driver while allegedly under the influence of alcohol and ganja.

Sources said the accused demanded money and alcohol from Venkatesh. When he refused and claimed he had no cash, the duo allegedly turned violent.

The attackers reportedly used cutting pliers and screwdrivers taken from the auto-rickshaw to assault him inside the vehicle. In an attempt to save himself, Venkatesh jumped out of the auto and tried to escape.

However, the accused allegedly chased him on the road and continued attacking him with wooden sticks and iron rods in full public view. CCTV footage and videos of the incident reportedly captured the entire sequence.

Witnesses said the victim folded his hands and pleaded with the attackers to stop, but the assault continued. At one point, the attackers allegedly struck him with such force that the wooden sticks broke.

Locals who witnessed the attack were left terrified and reportedly did not intervene. Some residents described the brutality as resembling scenes from an action film.

Bystanders later alerted the police, and the injured driver was shifted for treatment. Reports suggest that he sustained serious injuries but is now out of danger.

A complaint has been registered at KR Puram Police Station, and police have launched an investigation. Officials are examining CCTV footage to trace and arrest the accused.

The incident has raised fresh concerns among auto drivers and residents over increasing violence and lawlessness in Bengaluru, with many demanding stricter action against anti-social elements.

body.html:
A woman sustained injuries in a hit-and-run incident after being knocked down by an unidentified car while crossing the road near the Anandapur bus stand in Sagar taluk of Shivamogga district.

According to reports, the accident took place near the busy bus stand area when the woman was attempting to cross the road. The unidentified vehicle allegedly hit her and fled the scene without stopping.

The entire incident was reportedly captured on nearby CCTV cameras, which are now expected to help police identify the vehicle and trace the driver involved.

Local residents rushed to the woman’s aid immediately after the accident and shifted her to a nearby hospital for treatment.

The case falls under the jurisdiction of the Anandapur Police Station. Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the hit-and-run incident.

articles.title: “Hotel Horror in Ghaziabad”: Viral Video Shows Woman Manager Assaulted Inside Hotel, Accused Arrest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident from Ghaziabad’s Indirapuram area has sparked outrage after a viral video allegedly showed a young man assaulting a woman hotel manager inside a hotel premises.

body.html:
A shocking incident from Ghaziabad’s Indirapuram area has sparked outrage after a viral video allegedly showed a young man assaulting a woman hotel manager inside a hotel premises.

The incident reportedly took place at Hotel Yuvraj in the Shakti Khand area under the limits of Indirapuram Police Station. The woman involved in the case has been identified as Priyanka, who was working as the hotel manager, while the accused has been identified as Shivam.

The video of the incident has been circulating widely on social media, triggering sharp reactions and criticism online. Following the complaint filed by the woman, police registered a case and confirmed that the accused Shivam has been taken into custody.

According to officials, further investigation is underway to determine when the video was recorded and what led to the dispute inside the hotel. Authorities are also examining the viral footage as part of the probe.

Police stated that appropriate legal action is being taken in the matter.

articles.title: Woman Dragged on Road While Trying to Stop Phone Snatchers in Ludhiana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking CCTV video from Ludhiana shows a woman being dragged on the road while trying to stop bike-borne phone snatchers near New Kirti Nagar.

body.html:
A shocking CCTV video from Ludhiana shows a woman being dragged on the road while trying to stop bike-borne phone snatchers near New Kirti Nagar.

The woman was sitting outside her house and talking on her phone when 3 youths on a motorcycle allegedly approached her pretending to ask for directions. Within seconds, one of them snatched her mobile phone and tried to flee.

In a desperate attempt to stop them, the woman grabbed one of the accused, but the riders allegedly sped away, dragging her across the road before throwing her onto the street and escaping.

The entire incident was caught on CCTV under the Moti Nagar police station area. Residents say incidents of theft and snatching have been rising in the locality. Police are investigating the case.

articles.title: RJD MLA Rahul Kumar’s Brother Targeted in Chain Snatching Incident in Patna
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The brother of Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) MLA Rahul Kumar became the victim of a chain-snatching incident in Bihar’s capital Patna after two bike-borne assailants allegedly targeted him near a temple.

body.html:
The brother of Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) MLA Rahul Kumar became the victim of a chain-snatching incident in Bihar’s capital Patna after two bike-borne assailants allegedly targeted him near a temple.

The incident took place near Sai Mandir under the jurisdiction of Kankarbagh Police Station on Friday.

According to police, the victim, Rohit Kumar, was passing through the area when two unidentified men on a motorcycle allegedly approached him, snatched the gold chain from his neck, and fled within seconds.

The entire incident was captured on nearby CCTV cameras.

The footage reportedly shows the accused arriving on a motorcycle, executing the chain snatching swiftly, and escaping from the spot while locals looked on in shock.

Soon after the incident, a crowd gathered in the area, creating panic and tension among residents.

After receiving information, police personnel from Kankarbagh Police Station reached the scene and launched an investigation.

Station House Officer Abhay Kumar stated that preliminary findings suggest the involvement of two criminals in a planned chain-snatching operation.

Police teams are currently examining CCTV footage from nearby areas and using technical surveillance along with local intelligence inputs to identify and trace the accused.

Officials expressed confidence that the accused would be arrested soon.

The incident has once again highlighted growing concerns over rising chain-snatching and street robbery cases in Patna.

Police sources noted that motorcycle-borne criminals have increasingly been targeting pedestrians and women, especially during evening hours, creating fear among residents in several parts of the city.

articles.title: Woman Fined After Allegedly Damaging KSRTC Bus During Dispute Over Unscheduled Stop in Kozhikode
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young woman was reportedly fined after allegedly damaging a KSRTC Superfast Premium bus following an argument with the driver and conductor over an unauthorised stop near MIMS/Lulu Mall in Kozhikode.

body.html:
A young woman was reportedly fined after allegedly damaging a KSRTC Superfast Premium bus following an argument with the driver and conductor over an unauthorised stop near MIMS/Lulu Mall in Kozhikode.

The incident, which was captured on video and widely circulated on social media, took place on a KSRTC Superfast Premium bus operating on the Kattappana–Pulpally route.

According to reports, the woman repeatedly demanded that the bus stop near MIMS in Kozhikode.

However, the driver and conductor allegedly informed her multiple times that the location was not an authorised stop and that they could not halt the service there.

Despite repeated explanations from the KSRTC staff, the passenger allegedly continued arguing and created a disturbance inside the bus.

In the viral video, the crew members can reportedly be heard explaining that the bus could not stop at a non-designated location.

The situation later escalated when the woman allegedly used an object to smash the side glass near the driver’s seat.

She also reportedly attempted to record videos of the driver and conductor on her mobile phone and allegedly stated that she would file a police complaint against them.

The footage further shows the woman confronting the staff and questioning why they were recording her while continuing to insist on stopping the bus near MIMS.

Following the incident, the KSRTC bus was reportedly taken directly to a police station, where both the passenger and the bus staff submitted complaints.

According to available information, authorities later released the woman after she reportedly agreed to bear the repair cost for the damaged bus.

Reports said a penalty of around ₹28,000 was imposed for the damage caused to public property, although some social media posts claimed the amount was ₹25,000.

The incident has triggered widespread debate online, with many social media users praising the KSRTC driver and conductor for remaining calm during the confrontation.

Further action, if any, is expected to depend on the outcome of the police inquiry.

articles.title: Woman, Husband and Brother Allegedly Conspired to Murder Lover, Dumped Body in Drum Near Mumbai
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chilling murder case from the Mumbra area near Mumbai has shocked residents after police uncovered an alleged conspiracy in which a woman, along with her husband and brother, brutally killed her lover and dumped his body inside a drum in a drain.

body.html:
A chilling murder case from the Mumbra area near Mumbai has shocked residents after police uncovered an alleged conspiracy in which a woman, along with her husband and brother, brutally killed her lover and dumped his body inside a drum in a drain.

The sensational “blind murder” case was cracked by Mumbra Police through technical surveillance, mobile tower analysis, and call detail record investigations.

The victim was identified as Arbaaz Maqsood Ali Khan, a resident of Mumbra.

According to police, the case began on August 3, 2026, when Arbaaz left home after informing his family that he was travelling to Dadar for work. However, he never returned, and his phone later became unreachable.

After repeated attempts to trace him failed, his father filed a missing person complaint at Mumbra Police Station.

During the investigation, police analysed Arbaaz’s call detail records and mobile location history. Officials discovered that his phone was last active in the Versova area.

Further technical analysis allegedly revealed that his girlfriend, identified as Mehjabeen Sheikh, was also present in the same area at the same time.

This location match reportedly raised suspicion and led investigators to question her.

Police said Mehjabeen initially denied involvement and allegedly gave contradictory statements. However, during sustained interrogation and after being confronted with technical evidence, she reportedly confessed to the crime.

According to police, Mehjabeen revealed that she, along with her husband Hasan and brother Tariq Sheikh, had planned to extort money from Arbaaz.

Investigators said the accused allegedly lured Arbaaz to Versova on the pretext of a financial deal.

When the expected money was not received, the situation allegedly turned violent.

Police stated that the accused tied Arbaaz’s hands and brutally assaulted him with a plastic pipe, resulting in his death.

To destroy evidence, the accused allegedly stuffed the body into a large green drum and transported it to a secluded drain in the Mumbra area, where it was dumped.

Following the confession, police arrested Mehjabeen Sheikh and her brother Tariq Sheikh.

A case has been registered against four accused under charges related to murder, criminal conspiracy, and destruction of evidence.

However, Mehjabeen’s husband Hasan and another accused, identified as Muzammal Pathan, are currently absconding.

Police said raids are underway to trace and arrest the remaining accused.

Officials stated that the case highlights the growing importance of digital forensics and technical surveillance in solving complex criminal investigations.

Further investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Salesgirl Allegedly Flees With Gold Jewellery Worth ₹1.66 Crore From Ahmedabad Showroom
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A salesgirl working at a jewellery showroom in Ahmedabad has allegedly absconded with gold jewellery worth nearly ₹1.66 crore, prompting a major police investigation.

body.html:
A salesgirl working at a jewellery showroom in Ahmedabad has allegedly absconded with gold jewellery worth nearly ₹1.66 crore, prompting a major police investigation.

The incident was reported from the Nikol area, where the accused was employed at a showroom named “Gravity Shopping Mall – Aabhushan.”

According to reports, showroom owner Darshanbhai Shah, a resident of Nayan Nagar Society in the Krishnanagar area, runs the gold and silver jewellery store near Anmol Circle in Nikol.

The showroom reportedly employs 19 staff members, including managers, sales executives, and marketing staff.

The accused, identified as Harshida Shetty, had been working as a salesgirl at the showroom for the past 11 months.

Police said the incident came to light on May 11, 2026, after the showroom owner briefly left for home in the afternoon while other staff members remained at the store.

Around 5 pm, after the owner returned, a customer visited the showroom to make a purchase. During the process, a staff member reportedly noticed that a gold coin was missing from one of the jewellery trays.

Soon afterward, Harshida was also found missing from the showroom.

When contacted over the phone, she allegedly claimed she had left early due to urgent personal work. However, the owner stated that no permission for leave had been granted.

Growing suspicious, the showroom management reviewed CCTV footage from the premises.

According to the complaint, the footage allegedly showed Harshida Shetty removing gold jewellery from a cabinet behind her seat between 4 pm and 4:30 pm and concealing the items inside her clothing.

She was later reportedly seen going to the showroom’s second-floor storage section before leaving the premises carrying a bag.

Police said her mobile phone was later found switched off.

Following a detailed stock verification, the showroom allegedly discovered that jewellery worth approximately ₹1.66 crore was missing.

The stolen items reportedly include gold chains, lockets, watches, earrings, mangalsutras, pendants, and rings.

The Nikol Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to trace the accused, who remains absconding.

articles.title: Woman Killed After Scorpio Rams Into Bus Stop Crowd in Telangana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident claimed the life of a woman and left two others injured after a speeding Scorpio allegedly lost control and crashed into people waiting at a bus stop in Telangana.

body.html:
A tragic road accident claimed the life of a woman and left two others injured after a speeding Scorpio allegedly lost control and crashed into people waiting at a bus stop in Telangana.

The incident took place on Wednesday, May 13, at Gajasingaram bus stop near Raja Rajeshwar Rao Colony in Gambhiraopet mandal of Rajanna Sircilla district.

The deceased has been identified as Lakshmi (35).

The injured were identified as Rajitha and her son, Yashwanth.

According to reports, the victims were waiting to board a bus when the accident occurred.

A video circulating on social media reportedly shows Lakshmi, Rajitha and Yashwanth standing near the bus stop moments before a speeding Scorpio suddenly rammed into them.

Initial reports suggest the Scorpio driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle while attempting to overtake a bus.

The impact reportedly dragged Lakshmi for several metres, causing fatal injuries.

The two injured victims were rushed for medical treatment.

The shocking incident has triggered concern over reckless driving and overspeeding near public transport areas.

Police are expected to examine CCTV footage and investigate the exact circumstances leading to the crash.

Further details regarding the case are awaited.
